reasons.message: The proof statement is about core-wasm/prism_calculator_core_wasm.wasm with blake3 2adca3e7ca42d7415a5227a20002baad90047d087249cbb9ea36e557f5a4a380, which is not this holo's guest (blake3 0b5bbdb716fa46ca83096e030bb3e18207b2bc4bc53759584e2c9fe9b4cbf4a9).

The proof is about another model: the model document digests are not those of the model blob; model.document.sha256 is not the extension's model_id; model.sourceId is not the extension's source_id; model.semanticId is not the extension's semantic_id; model.snapshotId is not the extension's snapshot_id; model.compilerSemanticsId is not the extension's compiler_semantics_id; model.leanManifestSha256 is not the extension's lean_manifest_sha256.
The holo carries no replay statement (issue #284).
The level is P1; the policy requires P2 or above.
